high_level_description: This image is a comparison of the Martand Sun Temple in Kashmir, showcasing its historical transformation over time. Text: The top section includes the title "MARTAND SUN TEMPLE, KASHMIR" followed by a note that it was "Destroyed by Sultan Sikandar Shah Miri in 1401." Illustration: Below the text, there is an illustration depicting the temple as it might have looked around 760 AD. The drawing shows a grand structure with multiple domes and a large rectangular pool surrounding it. The background features a landscape with greenery and hills
